label: D2 transition code: high after rare a2->S1, low after a1->S2 / a2->S2
terms: (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * table(prev_action, {1: -1, 2: 1}) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_state == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_state == 1) * (prev_reward == 1)
explanation: Raw candidate n of unit 13 is set mostly by timing (high at D1, saturated near -0.95 at GO, about -0.5 at D2; timing R^2 0.87). Beyond timing, the main driver is the choice x reached state shown at D2: much higher after the rare a2->S1 transition (+0.87), slightly up for a1->S1, lower for a1->S2 (-0.46) and a2->S2 (-0.31). So at D2 it mainly signals reaching S1, especially after choosing a2. At D1 it is higher after a previous a2 choice than after a1, and a little lower after a reward. Smaller D2 effects: higher when the previous trial was a1->S2, lower on a1->S1 trials that repeat a rewarded a1->S1 trial. GO hardly varies. All cues are observed at their step (no future or hidden variables). Dev R^2 beyond timing 0.85 (0.81 with only the D2 code plus the D1 previous-action term); adding the model value at D2 adds only 0.005. Profile all ceiling 0.94.

issues: The scores reproduce: test R^2 beyond timing is 0.8409 with the stated weights (a2S1 at D2 +0.87, a1S2 -0.55, a2S2 -0.31, D1 prev_action +0.094, D1 prev_reward -0.049, D2 previous a1S2 +0.19, D2 repeated rewarded a1S1 -0.045).

The factual claims check out against the profile. D2 residuals by choice x state are a1S1 +0.12, a1S2 -0.48, a2S1 +0.90, a2S2 -0.28. At D1, residuals are higher after a2 (+0.03 to +0.11) than after a1 (-0.13 to -0.03), and lower after rewarded trials in 3 of 4 cells.

On test, the D2 code plus the D1 previous-action term alone give 0.818. Adding the D1 reward term brings it to 0.824 (+0.006), and adding the D2 previous-a1S2 term instead brings it to 0.835 (+0.017). Both are real but small, which matches the explanation calling them minor.

The D1 residual tracks the model's policy decile (+0.13 down to -0.13), and this is only partly captured by the previous action. Adding (phase == D1) * choice (a model-output cue) raises test R^2 to 0.856. That is a modest gap, not a large one.

The misses show no large systematic error class. Mean error by phase is GO -0.027 and D2 +0.027, and the largest error for any (phase, previous trial) cell is about 0.06 to 0.11. The worst windows are whole episodes where the D1 level and the a2->S1 D2 value run about 0.3 to 0.4 below the prediction. Value, episode time and prev_action interactions at D2 do not explain this.
Minor wording point: 'slightly higher for a1->S1' is relative to the timing baseline mean, not to a fitted term. a1S1 is the reference category in the terms.
